Name: Giant Crop alternative for PPJA Fruits And Veggies
Author: kobaltbleu
Description:
A pack of sprites to add to PPJA Fruits And Veggies for giant crop variations!

The sprites are of varying quality because at the start of this 18 hour art-a-thon I had never made pixel art before and improved SIGNIFICANTLY over the course of this. I may go back and fix them sometime. I also may not. Feel free to delete any files you deem too ugly hahah. (Looking at you, Chives.)

To apply, extract the Crops folder into your Mods/[PPJA] Fruits And Veggies/[JA] Fruits And Veggies. 

Requires: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]PPJA Fruits and Veggies[/url] and all of their dependencies!
